title: TextSpan
description: A span of a text: the code points from `start` up to but not including `end`, the words they are, and maybe the text just before and just after them.

Members.description: TextSpan's members, open, for a schema that holds them and more of its own.

start.description: The offset the span starts at, in Unicode code points from the text's start.

end.description: The offset just past the span, in Unicode code points from the text's start.
